fib: ______ refers to social convention about right and wrong human conduct that are so widely shared that they form a stable (although usually incomplete) communal consensus.
Moral
Moral refers to social convention about right and wrong human conduct that are so widely shared that they form a stable (although usually incomplete) communal consensus.
______ are concerned with the ethical questions that arise in the relationships among life sciences, biotechnology, medicine and medical ethics, politics, law, theology and philosophy.
Bioethics
Bioethics are concerned with the ethical questions that arise in the relationships among life sciences, biotechnology, medicine and medical ethics, politics, law, theology and philosophy.
______ is a body of the terms used in nursing.
nursing terminology
A nursing terminology is a body of the terms used in nursing.
______ is a conflict between alternatives, where choosing any of them will lead to a compromise of some ethical principle and lead to an ethical violation.
ethical dilemma
An ethical dilemma is a conflict between alternatives, where choosing any of them will lead to a compromise of some ethical principle and lead to an ethical violation.
______ is a "set of elements developed consistent with the general concept of a Uniform Minimum Health Data Set (UMHDS) and specifically intended for the collection of essential nursing care data.

Nursing administration

______ refers to the process of making informed choices about ethical dilemmas based on a set of standards differentiating right from wrong.
Ethical decision making
